routes.name: Kenya Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA)
routes.summary: Every traveler to Kenya has to submit info online before departure. Skipping it can mean being denied boarding or a penalty fee on arrival.

other: Official site says all travelers must submit information before departure.

Fee, validity, stay length and exemptions (including any 2025-2026 visa-free changes for African or Caribbean countries) could not be confirmed. Details not confirmed on an official page. Check the official site before applying.

routes.name: Visa-free and exempt nationalities
routes.summary: Some nationalities can enter Kenya without a visa but still need to register via the eTA before travel. The official exempt list was not reachable.

other: Details not confirmed on an official page. Check the official site before applying.

routes.name: Class N Digital Nomad Permit (KEP/N)
routes.summary: For people working remotely from Kenya for a foreign-registered company or foreign clients. Issued for 1 or 2 years and renewable.

other: Work under a contract with a foreign company, be a shareholder or run business for a foreign company, or be self-employed for clients outside Kenya.
No minimum income stated. Bank statements or payslips for the last 3 months are required.
Letter of no objection from your home country's embassy is required.

sources.label: Class N Digital Nomad Permit, Kenya Immigration

steps: Create an account on the Government of Kenya Single Sign On portal and log in to eFNS.
Select Apply now, then Permit Issuance/Renewal, and fill in Form 25.
Pay the invoice under the Payments tab, or print the application and pay at Nyayo House, Nairobi.
Track progress by email and portal notifications.
documents: Current immigration status if already in Kenya
Signed cover letter to the Director General of Immigration Services
Signed cover letter from employer or company
Bank statements or payslips for last 3 months
Letter of no objection from home country embassy

routes.name: Class K Ordinary Resident Permit (KEP/K)
routes.summary: Residence for people 35 or older with a steady income from outside Kenya or a pension, who won't work in Kenya.

income.note: Assured annual income from abroad or a pension

other: No employment or income-generating activity without the right permit.
Validity period not stated on the page.

documents: Proof of income of at least USD 24,000 a year
Tax Compliance Certificate for new applications

routes.name: Class G Trade, Business or Consultancy Permit (KEP/G)
routes.summary: For people running a specific trade, business or consultancy in Kenya, alone or in partnership.

investment.note: Proof of capital to be invested

other: Must hold any needed license or registration.
Must benefit Kenya.
Validity period not stated on the page.
